summary: Correctly rewrites _check_list_display_item to try get_field then getattr, returning E108 only when both fail, matching the issue's recommended fix and resolving the false E108 on instance-only descriptor fields like PositionField. Minimal, general, and consistent with existing E108/E109 semantics — this is essentially the canonical upstream fix.

issues.description: The `field` variable is assigned across two try/except branches before the isinstance check; while every path reaching the check is guaranteed to bind it, a brief comment would make the control flow easier to follow for future readers.
